title: SC09 eval-bundle.schema.json -- the frozen eval bundle S15 emits and the scored verdict S16 derives from it (08-EVAL-STRATEGY.md §1.6 verified-落库定义 + 五元组审计 + §1.3 四条前置)
description: Writer: S15 kd_eval_freeze (stage='freeze'); readers: S16 kd_eval_score (emits a stage='score' document derived from the frozen bundle) and S09 kd_validate as the sole witness (12-SKILL-DESIGN-BRIEF.md:171). Contract rows: 12:123 (S15 冻结语料 + fixture + exam isolation 结果, exit 2 = 隔离被破坏) and 12:124 (S16 verdict + 五元组审计记录, exit 2 = 裁决量具 id 与循环内 metric id 相同), SC09 row 12:185. Two failure modes this field set exists to block, both from Round 1/2 evidence: (1) LEAKAGE -- if the answer is visible to the model under evaluation the score is meaningless (12:244 '语料与 split 由 S15 持有（否则模型能看见答案，eval 失效）', 08:45 prerequisite (d)); that is why `answer_material` is a separate file set with visibility 'adjudicator-only' and why `isolation` must carry the surfaces actually scanned, not an assertion of cleanliness. (2) SELF-GRADING -- the instrument that adjudicates must not be the metric the optimisation loop maximises (08:42 prerequisite (a), 08:92 P-01); that is why `five_tuple.instrument_also_optimised_against` is a required slot, and 08:68 makes it '本文全部硬禁令的落点'. No numeric threshold is defaulted anywhere in this schema: `prerequisites.c.thresholds` slots are nullable, and a null value means prerequisite (c) is unsatisfied, which makes Tier-2 invalid and falls back to Tier-1 or Tier-4 (08:41).

schema_version.description: SC09's own version, bumped only when the field set changes so a stale reader is distinguishable from a new writer.

stage.description: Which of the two documents this is. 'freeze' is S15's frozen corpus (no run has happened, so nothing may be claimed); 'score' is S16's verdict derived from a freeze document plus before/after run results. 08 §1.1 (08:24) is the reason the split exists: a structural/freezing pass produces no verified record, so the discriminator's whole job is to make 'not yet run' unrepresentable as 'passed'.

at.description: Instant captured ONCE per call and reused by every row this document renders (05-DATA-MODEL.md §2 时间戳取一次).

dataset_id.description: Five-tuple slot 2's authority (08:67 样本/数据集 id). S16 must echo it verbatim: a verdict stamped against a different corpus id than the frozen one is not the same measurement.

bundle_digest.description: SHA-256 over the question side plus every answer-file digest: the immutability claim of 'frozen'. S16 recomputes it and refuses on mismatch, which is the mechanism behind prerequisite (d)'s second half and P-11 (08:102 'DO UPDATE SET expected 改写历史验收').

subject.description: CM-48 regression-eval-for-promoted-rule (MUST, 06:266): the eval is tied to the promoted rule/artifact, and it must be able to identify the ORIGINAL defect. An eval with no `promoted_from_artifact_id` measures a corpus, not a promotion; a corpus whose sample set excludes `original_failure_sample_id` cannot fail on the old behaviour and is therefore decorative (08:29 '测试必须咬得住（把被宣称的门删掉，测试必须变红）').

promoted_from_artifact_id.description: The SC04 artifact whose promotion this bundle adjudicates. 12:498 routes M4's 题面 through this bundle, so the tie is what makes the eval a regression eval (CM-48).

original_failure_sample_id.description: The sample that reproduced the defect before the change. Tier-1's default standard IS this sample re-run (08:27-08:29), so it must be named at freeze time, before any score exists.

sample_kind.description: Decides which tier can grant `verified` per 08:65 (`Tier-1 若样本可复现 ∨ Tier-2 若为可泛化文本资产`). 'undecided' is a legal stored value: 08 §8 D08-3 / DEFERRED id DD-3-sub24 leaves the candidate-kind distribution of Round 3 undetermined, and 08:151 flags '若 candidate 绝大多数是纯 prompt 资产则 Tier-1 失主口径' as ENGINEERING-INFERENCE. `verified` is therefore not grantable from a Tier-1 rerun while this says 'undecided'.

reproducible_rerun_claimed.description: Operator-declared, never inferred: whether the original failure can actually be re-run in this environment. null = not stated, and null must render as unverified rather than default to true (08:57 §1.5 forbids promoting without a verifiable sample).

splits.description: The three-split disk contract of CM-46 / `07:rubric-based-eval-split-contract` (08:46), each an array of `samples[].sample_id`. Split membership is frozen here so 'which set was adjudicated' is checkable after the fact.

holdout.description: minItems 1 is load-bearing: an empty holdout is the exact shape of 08 §2 rejected alternative 1 and of P-10 (08:101 '.evals/cases/ 为空' while the README claimed an eval loop). The adjudicating set must exist and be non-empty.

samples.description: The question side of the corpus only. `07:rubric-based-eval-split-contract`'s five fields (task_input / expected_behavior / difficulty / category / source, 08:46) are carried per sample; the gold answer is NOT, it lives in `answer_material`.

answer_material.description: The answer side: gold answers plus the adjudication keys, kept in files this schema can name and hash but never embed. `visibility` is const 'adjudicator-only' because a model-visible answer voids the score (08:45 prerequisite (d), 12:244).

visibility.description: No other value is representable: a bundle that declares its answers model-visible is not an eval bundle.

files.description: Each entry is an absolute, symlink-resolved path plus its SHA-256. S15 proves isolation over exactly this list, so an empty list would be a guard with nothing to check (see `isolation.status`'s dead-man).

isolation.description: S15's exam-isolation gate result -- the proof, not the claim. `08` never had a runnable implementation of this (11:exam-isolation-gate is UNVERIFIED, 08:159 / DEFERRED id DD-3-sub22), so the field set records WHICH surfaces were resolved and HOW MANY loadable documents were actually read. A clean result over zero scanned documents is not clean, it is unscanned: see the if/then below plus `IsolationBreach` handling in kd_eval_freeze.py.

status.description: 'proven-clean' requires at least one surface, at least one loadable document read, and zero breaches. 'breach' is S15's exit 2. 'unscanned' is the honest value when a declared surface yielded nothing readable -- S15 refuses with exit 3 rather than emitting a passing bundle.

method.description: How a model-visible surface was resolved (host-loadable document shapes + realpath containment + verbatim answer-substring test) and what it cannot catch: a paraphrased or truncated leak. `11:exam-isolation-gate`'s registered risk is '只查前缀 60 字符的连续原文，改写/截半的泄漏查不到'; this implementation compares the WHOLE normalised answer string rather than its first 60 characters, and still cannot see a rewrite. Recorded as an IMPLEMENTATION_GAP in kd_eval_freeze.py.

surfaces.description: One row per model-visible surface root the operator declared (e.g. a host skills root, a rules root, this package's own references tree). Declaring none is refused by S15 before a bundle exists, so `minItems 1` cannot be satisfied vacuously.

breaches.description: Empty whenever `status` is proven-clean (the if/then below). S15 never publishes a bundle on a breach -- it exits 2 with the rows on stdout -- so a non-empty list here comes from S16's score-time recheck: answer bytes moved or became model-visible after the freeze, which is why slot 4 cannot certify anything. The rows also go to --out / stderr.

checked_at.description: Isolation is a per-run fact, not a one-time stamp: a host skills root gains documents between runs. S16 re-checks and refuses if the result predates the current filesystem state.

prerequisites.description: 08 §1.3's four mandatory prerequisites, one field each, 08:41: '缺一即 Tier-2 无效，退回 Tier-1 或 Tier-4'. Encoding them as four required fields is what stops a Tier-2 claim that quietly rests on only (a).

a_instrument_separation.description: (a) 08:42 量具分离硬断言：裁决所用 metric 的 id 必须 ≠ 循环内优化所用 metric 的 id，且写成断言而非约定. `asserted_not_conventional` is the field that makes the difference explicit: a convention can drift, an assertion is what S16 runs (P-01, 08:92).

b_floor_ceiling.description: (b) 08:43 floor / ceiling 双参照：同时报告 baseline-noop 与 oracle (`01:floor-ceiling-bench-corpus`, 08:43). Both slots are nullable: 08 §7 item 4 makes them a HARD constraint only once `01`'s bench solvers reproduce 0/3->3/3, which has not happened (DEFERRED id DD-3-sub23), so an unsatisfied (b) is recorded as unsatisfied rather than faked with a synthesized floor.

c_min_improvement_repeats_tolerance.description: (c) 08:44 最小改进量 + 重复次数 + 容差，且变差即 FAILED / 阻断（不允许「只警告不阻断」）. The three numbers are NOT in this schema and NOT in promotion-config.json: Round 2 left them undecided, so nullable slots plus `status: unsatisfied` are the only honest representation until an operator supplies them.

thresholds.description: A null here means 'undecided', never '0' -- defaulting min_improvement to 0 is precisely P-02 (08:93 禁止 improvement > 0 当阈值).

values_from.description: Where the numbers came from (an operator-supplied contract file, a config key). 'defaulted by kd_eval_score' is not a legal provenance and does not occur.

d_leakage_and_attribution.description: (d) 08:45 泄漏与归因前置：新纠正不得只进 train；验收标准（expected）不得被静默改写. Two separate fields because P-11 (08:102) is the second half and 08:159 notes (d) is not yet a MUST gate (DEFERRED id DD-3-sub22) -- so its status is recorded as evidence, not assumed.

acceptance_criteria_immutable.description: true only when every answer file's digest matches the frozen digest AND no expected value was rewritten between freeze and score. S16 recomputes it; a bundle's own claim is not trusted.

five_tuple.description: 08 §1.6 (08:67): 每条 verified 必须携带五元组（量具 id、样本/数据集 id、阈值、运行结果、该量具是否同时被用于优化）. All five are required so a verdict missing one cannot be written at all; 08:68 makes the fifth slot the data-layer detection point for every ban in 08 §3. Slot 4 is what S16 hands to the write path as the SC04 `verification[]` row -- CM-50 gets no script of its own and is enforced jointly by S10 + S16 + S12 (12:140), so this object is the shared contract between them.

instrument_id.description: Slot 1 量具 id. S16 refuses (exit 2) if it equals any `prerequisites.a_instrument_separation.loop_metric_ids` entry.

dataset_id.description: Slot 2 样本/数据集 id -- must equal the top-level `dataset_id`.

threshold.description: Slot 3 阈值 -- the (c) triple as actually applied to this verdict, echoed from `prerequisites...thresholds`. Object only when the numbers exist; null when they were never decided (then Tier-2 cannot grant verified).

run_result.description: Slot 4 运行结果 -- null at stage 'freeze' (nothing ran; P-10, 08:101 forbids letting the spec's existence stand in for a run) and an object at stage 'score'.

instrument_also_optimised_against.description: Slot 5: whether the same evaluation instrument was also used for optimization; this is where the prohibition is enforced. `collision` is computed, not declared: kd_eval_score compares instrument_id against loop_metric_ids and exits 2 on equality.

checked_by.description: The one script that may compute this slot, so no other surface can restate the equality check as a note.

verdict.description: S16's adjudication. The `status` enum is the schema-level enforcement of 08:44/P-02 (08:93): there is no 'warning', 'review', 'yellow' or 'needs-attention' member available, so a worse-than-baseline run CANNOT be written as anything but FAILED. A one-token schema edit would reintroduce the bug; `test_verdict_enum_has_no_non_blocking_member` in tests/knowledge-compiler/test_w3c_eval.py reads this enum and fails if a soft member appears.

status.description: NOT_RUN = stage freeze only. PASSED = Tier-2 (or Tier-1) arithmetic met the recorded threshold. FAILED = worse than baseline, or better by less than min_improvement, or fewer repeats than declared -- always blocking. UNVERIFIED = a legal stored state with no promotion right (08:55-08:59 §1.5).

blocking.description: true for FAILED and UNVERIFIED. A FAILED with blocking=false is the '只标黄' shape the contract row forbids (12:124), so the pair is checked in code as well as here.

reasons.description: A closed reason vocabulary: an empty reasons array is unrepresentable (minItems 1) so 'FAILED' can never arrive without a nameable cause, and no free-text reason can soften it.

verified.description: 08 §1.6 落库定义 (08:64-08:68, 12:458): verified := Tier-0 ∧ (Tier-1 若样本可复现 ∨ Tier-2 若为可泛化文本资产). Computed by kd_eval_score from THIS document's fields, never copied from the bundle: a stage='freeze' document's own claim is structurally false. P-06/P-07 (08:97-08:98) are why this is a derived boolean rather than an input: a stored 'verified' that nothing recomputes is a mood.

regression_detected.description: Slot 4's headline fact: any drop against the frozen baseline, including one unit. `verdict.status` must be FAILED whenever this is true (enforced in kd_eval_score.score_bundle, tested both ways).

provenance.description: Which deterministic script wrote this document and with what model budget. `model_id` is const 'none': Tier-2's corpus, split and isolation are held by S15 precisely so no model sees the answers (12:244), and 08 §1.4 keeps LLM-as-judge out of Round 3's acceptance path (12:261 judge = DEFERRED).

contract_row.description: The 12-SKILL-DESIGN-BRIEF.md line this document's contract came from (12:123 / 12:124 / 12:185), so a reader can retrace the ruling without searching.

notes.description: Machine-readable gap register so an undecided parameter is never buried in prose.

IMPLEMENTATION_GAPS.description: Each entry 'IMPLEMENTATION_GAP: <what> / DEFERRED id <...>'. A gap entry naming no DEFERRED id must say 'DEFERRED id none registered'.

sample.description: The five contract fields of `07:rubric-based-eval-split-contract` (08:46; reference shape task_input / expected_behavior / difficulty / category / source) plus the two slots this design adds: `gold_sha256` (the answer is hashed, never inlined) and `is_original_failure` (CM-48's bite tie).

task_input.description: What the model sees. S15 refuses (exit 2) when this sample's own gold answer appears inside it -- that is the exact defect `11:exam-isolation-gate` names (08:45, 12:244).

expected_behavior.description: The rubric, not the expected text (08:46 CM-46). Kept model-visible is acceptable ONLY for train/val: `answer_visibility` in the split contract decides, and holdout rubric text is treated as answer material by S15.

source.description: CM-46's provenance field for the sample. 'synthetic' samples bootstrapped from the artifact itself cannot support a verified claim alone (08:53: expected 源自同一条 learning = 用规则证明规则).

gold_sha256.description: Digest of the answer as stored in answer_material. The digest is safe to publish; the answer is not.

is_original_failure.description: Exactly one sample may say true, and it must be in the holdout (CM-48 / 08:29): Tier-1's default standard is 're-run the sample that first failed'.

answer_file.description: One answer-side file S15 froze. `path` is realpath-resolved because the isolation question is where the bytes actually are, not how the caller spelled them.

surface.description: One model-visible surface root as S15 resolved it.

loadable_documents_read.description: THE DEAD-MAN FIELD. minimum 1 means a surface row cannot certify cleanliness without having read at least one document a host could load; the reference this comes from is Round 2's two caught guards ('... or True', a regex that matched nothing). A root with nothing loadable gets `isolation.status: unscanned` and S15 exits 3.

answer_files_inside.description: How many of `answer_material.files` resolve inside this root. Any value > 0 is a breach (path-level leakage).

breach.description: One isolation breach. `document` and `sample_id` are enough to find the offending bytes without copying the answer into the report (global rule: raw answer material and full private context stay out of logs and reports).

kind.description: The three shapes S15 detects: the answer file sits where a host loads; some answer's text appears in a host-loadable document; a sample's own gold answer appears in its own task_input.

document.description: Absolute path of the offending loadable document (or the answer file, for kind answer-file-inside-surface).

excerpt_chars.description: How much normalised answer text was matched. This implementation matches the whole normalised answer, deliberately not a 60-character prefix (11:exam-isolation-gate's registered risk).
